mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index exceeds 200.0, it indicates persistent inflationary pressures that prompt central bank tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 200.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% signals a recessionary labor market that contracts corporate profit margins through reduced consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly payroll growth exceeds 135,000 jobs, it signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS exceeds 135,000, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5% and the Consumer Price Index exceeds 195.0, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy environment amid persistent inflation, suppressing corporate investment and consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both CPIAUCSL > 195.0 and FEDFUNDS > 2.5, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 2100.0 thousand units, it signals a late-cycle demand slowdown that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST falls below 2100.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
